formattedAddress: 10491, Taiwan, Taipei City, Zhongshan District, Zhengshou Village, 新生北路一段62巷16號

text.text: Perfect crispy NY style pizza by the slice! Good find in Taipei. Right next to the Syntrend tech mega-mall. Only about 10 seats inside; but a great vibe. Beer by the can and draft. Cash only!

text.text:
Red Hot Chili Peppers would be proud of this place. Plus they'd go well with pizza 😉
Rustic, punk and rock n roll vibes inside the quaint but cool atmosphere. Two kind individuals showed me where to enter this rather unique space. I googled best pizza options in Taipei, and this location came up. One look at the building, you could believe it's in NYC, but nope. Only a short  walk from Huashan 1914 Creative Park, you'll be able to salvage your appetite. I needed a small but good bite so I got myself the Small Clone - a signature slice. A very good, credible crust (fold), savory taste, and cooked to the right golden colour of crisp. I devoured the slice for obvious reason. As you can see, the dab of oil resembles a bear 🐻 I'm a happy bear. Great job UTB!

text.text:
A tiny pizzeria under the Xinsheng Expressway where you can by New York style pizza by the slice.

The slice is larger than ordinary pizza and the  thin crust was crispy and delicious, loved the cheese they used for the filling, creamy and packed with flavor.

Not many seats inside this small pizza joint but still worth a visit to grab a quick bite and a bottle of cold one.

text.text: I’m a Native New Yorker living in Taipei sort of a foodie. When I came here I was very skeptical that it would be “New York Style”. We ordered the cheese and basil pie and let me tell you, when I took a bite , I felt I was transported back to Manhattan. This was by far the most delicious pizza I’ve had in two years. I will definitely tell others and surely be back for more.
